summary: In amazon.aws, the iam_role create_instance_profile and delete_instance_profile options are deprecated and will be removed after 2026-05-01. Use amazon.aws.iam_instance_profile instead.
questions: Should I still create instance profiles with iam_role?
Which module manages IAM instance profiles now?
When will the iam_role instance profile options be removed?

answer_card.title: Managing IAM instance profiles
answer_card.answer_md: `iam_role`'s `create_instance_profile` and `delete_instance_profile` options are deprecated (removal after 2026-05-01). Use `amazon.aws.iam_instance_profile` to manage instance profiles.
